title.zh: 已完成的明确公理路线

scope.zh: 适用于8日对齐伦理奠基与方向任务，不对其他会话加完成门槛。
scope.en: Applies to the 8 October alignment grounding and direction task, without imposing completion gates on other sessions.

objective.zh: 复用 G0 与明确比较、责任和选择承诺下的实践判断与对齐方向。
objective.en: Reuse practical judgment and alignment direction under G0 and explicit comparison, responsibility and choice commitments.

premises.zh: 不要求规范起点自身的无公理证明；额外承诺不能藏入定义。
premises.en: Do not require an axiom-free proof of the normative starting point; additional commitments must not be hidden in definitions.

completion.zh: 完成状态以所连成果记录与既有独立审查为准；实际部署与更强目标另列。
completion.en: Completion follows linked result records and existing independent review; actual deployment and stronger targets remain separate.
